name: DiagEnc
description: DiagEnc is a medical image security system that performs CNN-based fracture detection to identify diagnostically critical regions, then applies selective AES-256 encryption to those regions while maintaining lossless image quality. RSA-2048 handles key exchange. Preserves DICOM metadata integrity. Patent filed. Designed for hospital PACS integration with radiologist workflow in mind. Outperforms uniform encryption schemes in both security and computational overhead.
reported_outcome: Patent Filed. 100% reconstruction quality with AES-RSA lossless encryption.
